projects.title: Vodafone Idea App
projects.description: Customer-facing mobile platform for one of India's largest telecom operators, covering revenue-critical journeys like recharge, account management and support. I owned modules end-to-end across 15+ production features. Built CMS-driven dynamic screens (Dashboard, Help & Support, My Account) with server-managed content and layouts, cutting dependency on app releases by 40%. Shipped LLM-powered chatbot experiences with LangChain, LangGraph and RAG that handle 30%+ of support queries autonomously. Delivered OTP-less login via digital credentials, a network diagnostics system and PWA integrations that enable self-service. Led an offline-first approach with client-side caching, reducing redundant API calls and cutting Dashboard load time by 20%. Handled Play Store releases: phased rollouts, hotfixes and post-release monitoring, sustaining 99.5%+ availability.

projects.title: Amazon Vega OS Ads SDK
projects.description: An end-to-end advertising SDK for Amazon's Vega OS, built in React Native and consumed by external engineering teams worldwide. Architected the SDK with client-side (CSAI) and server-side (DAI) ad insertion through Google IMA. Wrote the technical documentation and ran partner onboarding. Resolved integration issues with global client teams and provided ongoing production support. Improved ad playback success by ~18% while reducing player-related crashes.

projects.title: aha
projects.description: A multi-platform streaming experience across web and smart TVs, built from a shared codebase and led with a cross-functional team. Led a cross-functional team building Web (Next.js) and Smart TV (React.js) apps, including Samsung Tizen and LG webOS. Integrated Shaka Player and Google IMA for streaming and ad delivery. Removed unnecessary re-renders and optimized React rendering to improve playback and responsiveness. Designed a reusable UI component library that sped up feature delivery and standardized UI across multiple OTT products.

projects.title: News18 Smart TV
projects.description: A news application for Samsung Tizen and LG webOS supporting live channels and on-demand video. Built the app for Samsung Tizen and LG webOS with player SDK integrations and Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (ABR). Implemented content virtualization to keep navigation smooth on large feeds. Integrated ad SDKs to monetize the app through video advertising.
